findingDetails.title: Impossible date-shaped cutoff silently skips source-tag validation
findingDetails.evidence: cutoffDate accepts any YYYY-MM-DD-shaped prefix without checking that it is a real calendar date. main then skips a packet when its Created string is lexically <= the cutoff (line 314). For example, SPECKIT_SOURCE_TAG_CUTOFF=9999-99-99 passes the regex and causes valid dated packets to be skipped; the test only rejects a non-date string (check-source-tags.vitest.ts:197-201).
findingDetails.scopeProof: The function is the single cutoff parser used by main; the following Created comparison controls the early-return for every scanned packet. The helper test covers malformed shape but not impossible dates.
findingDetails.recommendation: Validate the complete override as a real calendar date before accepting it; fall back to CUTOFF_DEFAULT and report the existing note for impossible dates.

findingDetails.title: Valid YAML inline comments are included in frontmatter enum values
findingDetails.evidence: cleanScalar removes surrounding quotes but retains YAML comments. Thus a valid scalar such as contextType: planning # rationale becomes "planning # rationale" and validateBlock rejects it at lines 142-145. The spec-kit helper and Python validator use the same pattern: check-frontmatter-values-helper.cjs:57-59 and validate_document.py:1635-1639. Their tests cover aliases and outliers but not inline comments.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct reads show three independent readers retain trailing comment text before checking membership; the corresponding tests in check-frontmatter-values.vitest.ts, test_frontmatter_values.py, and skill-doc-frontmatter-checker.vitest.ts contain no inline-comment case.
findingDetails.recommendation: Parse these frontmatter scalars with YAML comment semantics (or a shared scalar parser) so valid inline comments do not create a false warning or checker failure.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A date-shaped but impossible environment override can skip all packet checks.

searchActions.result: The parser checks only a regular-expression shape, then main compares Created and cutoff strings and returns SKIP.
The malformed override case uses "soon" and does not exercise impossible calendar dates.

searchLedger.rationale: Impossible calendar dates pass the shape guard and can compare above every real packet date.

searchActions.result: Tests cover canonical values, aliases, outliers, and missing blocks; none covers a value with a trailing YAML comment.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Spaced tracked paths or known redirects could be classified as missing.

The source-tag integration case covers whole spaced filenames and independently split citations.

searchLedger.rationale: The inspected order and explicit spaced-path regression case support the expected resolution path.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No correctness defect found in the inspected spaced-path and redirect resolution direction.

searchLedger.rationale: The asymmetry is intentional and pinned by the shared test.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The document checker alias list and runtime legacy migration set have explicitly different contracts.
